title.narrative: Enhancing Conservation, Sustainability & Governance in CBC ocean realm

description.narrative: The UNEP/Caribbean Biological Corridor Project aims to enhance knowledge and management of marine and coastal areas in the Greater Antilles, including Cuba, Jamaica, Haiti, the Dominican Republic, and Puerto Rico. This initiative supports climate adaptation by increasing and making accessible vital information on how climate change impacts biodiversity. Through research, capacity building, and regional cooperation, the project seeks to strengthen conservation efforts and promote sustainable management of marine and coastal ecosystems in the Caribbean.
